summary.intent: Debug and fix failing E2E CI on all platforms after merging the phase 46 PR, then address CodeRabbit review comments on the open phase 47 PR (#494) and audit all mutative web paths for correct SDK-client routing.
summary.outcome: Root cause identified as contract drift in `edit-filepointer.mjs` from PR #488 (not phase 46); fix merged as PR #495 and validated green on all three platforms. Phase 47 PR #494 updated with CodeRabbit fixes, a `deleteFileVersion`/`restoreFileVersion` pin-leak fix, removal of dead upload code, and a captured todo for the remaining `useSharedWriteOps` routing gap.

repo: `ci-e2e.yml` has no `pull_request` trigger — runs only on push to main or manual dispatch, so SDK contract changes (like #488) are never E2E-tested before merge
The `desktop` path filter in `ci-e2e.yml` only watches `packages/crypto/src/**`, not `packages/sdk-core/**` or `tests/desktop-e2e/**`, so SDK changes don't trigger Desktop E2E even on main
E2E helper scripts in `packages/sdk-core/scripts/*.mjs` are not typechecked or linted — they silently drift from SDK contract changes and only fail in CI
NestJS `ValidationPipe` runs with `forbidNonWhitelisted: true` (confirmed in `main.ts`), so any unknown DTO property produces a fast deterministic 400 with no server-side error log

`updateFileMetadata` (post-#488) now publishes the file IPNS record internally and returns `{ ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids }` — it no longer returns `ipnsRecord`; `replaceFileInFolder` is now only used by the version-restore path

`useSharedWriteOps.ts` uses a `SharedWriteContext` / local refs pattern intentionally — shared-with-me folders are not tracked in the owner's SDK client `folderTree`, so direct `@cipherbox/sdk` function calls there are by-design, not a bug

`handleAddFile`/`handleAddFiles` in `useFileOperations.ts` (lines 44–334) were dead code using the old direct `sdk-core` publish pattern; the live upload path goes through `getSdkClient().uploadFiles()` via `useDropUpload.ts`

`deleteFileVersion` and `restoreFileVersion` web hooks were both discarding SDK-returned `prunedCids` from 409-conflict merge rounds, causing orphaned IPNS pins — now fixed to unpin the deduped union of web-computed and SDK-returned CIDs

Background + unsandboxed `git commit` (via `dangerouslyDisableSandbox`) is required for 1Password SSH-signed commits; the signer gets permanently wedged after a timed-out attempt and requires a 1Password app restart to recover

code.finding: Was destructuring `{ ipnsRecord }` from `updateFileMetadata` (now undefined post-#488) and passing it to `replaceFileInFolder`, producing `{ ipnsName: undefined, record: undefined }` → deterministic 400 on all platforms

Contract change from #488: `updateFileMetadata` publishes file IPNS record internally; return shape changed from `{ ipnsRecord, prunedCids }` to `{ ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids }` — confirmed in built `.d.ts`

`resolveIpnsRecord` + not-found throw ran before the `try` block, so `fileIpnsPrivateKey.fill(0)` in `finally` was skipped on resolution failures — moved both inside the `try` to satisfy T-47-01 caller-owned-zeroing requirement
Jitter formula `(0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5)` yields `[0.5, 1.0)` — one-sided bias (always early), not the documented ±50%. Fixed to `(0.5 + Math.random())` → `[0.5x, 1.5x)`

`deleteFileVersion` discarded the `updateFileMetadata` return including `prunedCids` from conflict-merge rounds. Its two sibling methods (`replaceFile` l.1172, `restoreFileVersion` l.1283) both capture and return them — was an inconsistency causing orphaned pins

`restoreFileVersion` hook unpinned only web-computed cap-pruning CIDs (`computeRestoreVersionUpdate`); SDK-returned `prunedCids` from 409-conflict merges were silently discarded — same leak class as `deleteFileVersion`

`handleAddFile` (l.44–175) and `handleAddFiles` (l.187–334) were dead code calling `sdk-core` `addFileToFolder`/`addFilesToFolder` directly, bypassing the SDK client `folderTree`. Active upload path is `useDropUpload.ts` → `getSdkClient().uploadFiles()`. Removed.

workflow: When CI logs are expired or too large for `gh run view --log`, download uploaded log artifacts with `gh run download` to access api.log and other structured logs
Manual workflow dispatch (`gh workflow run`) is required to trigger E2E on fix branches when `ci-e2e.yml` has no `pull_request` trigger; `--ref` sets the branch
Multi-lens adversarial review workflow before committing complex fixes catches edge cases (double-unpin, mock bleed, scope regression) that unit tests miss
CodeRabbit CLI (`coderabbit review --agent --base-commit <sha>`) used for offline diff reviews when GitHub rate-limited; scoping to branch merge-base is essential
Checking the built `.d.ts` files in dist is the authoritative way to verify what contract the SDK exports to its consumers (E2E scripts import from dist, not source)

friction: 1Password SSH signer gets permanently wedged after a timed-out `git commit` attempt — requires full 1Password app restart; `timeout 45` guard can trigger this condition
CI E2E logs expire or are too large to retrieve via `gh run view --log`; artifact download is a workaround but captures api.log only, not test stdout
`ci-e2e.yml` has no `pull_request` trigger, so the E2E gap that allowed #488's contract drift to reach main is structural — PRs are never E2E-tested before merge
The `desktop` path filter excludes `packages/sdk-core/**`, so SDK changes on main don't trigger Desktop E2E either, compounding the above
Phase-46 PR being docs-only meant the CI failure was initially misattributed to that merge rather than the earlier #488 code change
open_items: Add `packages/sdk-core/src/**`, `packages/sdk/src/**`, and `tests/desktop-e2e/**` to the `desktop` path filter in `ci-e2e.yml` so SDK contract changes trigger Desktop E2E on push to main
Optionally add a `pull_request` trigger to `ci-e2e.yml` so E2E runs before merge (separate PR from #495 fix)

Route `useSharedWriteOps` mutations through the SDK client for single folder-state ownership over shared folders — captured as GSD todo `.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-route-shared-folder-writes-through-the-sdk-client.md`
